title: Has anyone ever wished to dream of someone before falling asleep and then met them in your Mall World?
content: I was missing my ex (lol) and asked to dream of him In the dream, i came over to his place and he hugged me, said he missed me and asked me what was new. I told him about what I've had going on and he was happy and hugged me. He asked me if I wanted to stick around. He had all his mannerisms and the way he spoke was spot on. It felt real, like I was walking around this kitchen seeing that it looked like we were in the future--in some skyrise building with a cramped kitchen, dirty dishes. Anyway, it switched over to being in the auditorium and I was sitting next to another man now, who I thought was my ex still. But he was this other handsome guy giving me googly eyes. I very rarely have romantic dreams and when I do they've felt very intense and like the purest form of love I can feel. I also seem to lose my disability and anxiety.I normally struggle to speak but I feel a lot more ease socializing in my dreams. Bonus question: has anyone you dreamed of said they dreamed of you? My first bf told me he dreamed he'd meet me at the park after I had the same dream and we both showed up at the same time expecting to see the other lol. Life's crazy.
